applies_to: Weil-McLain SlimFit 1000-2000 boilers (SOLA control) fitted with the UPC BACnet translator kit 383-600-304.
summary: The UPC translator reads the SlimFit's Honeywell SOLA control over Modbus and publishes 144 BACnet objects (BACnet MS/TP or ARC156). They cover active setpoints, demand and burner states, temperatures, fan speed, flame signal, lockout and alert history, lead/lag master and slave status, pump and burner counters, and paired write/status objects for CH, DHW, lead/lag, outdoor reset, frost protection and warm weather shutdown.
notes: Table 2 (Complete Map, pages 15-25) is listed here; Table 1 (pages 11-14) is a recommended subset of it.
BACnet over ARC156 is also supported by the UPC.
The Type column uses BAV/BBV/BALM/BVV; they are listed by their Object ID (AV or BV). BV 13, 14, 17 and 18 are alarm (BALM) objects.
Object 57 is printed as BV:57 although its type column says BAV and its neighbours are AVs.
AV 103 has no read/write mark (listed as read-only); AV 42 and AV 65 are marked opposite to their names.

integration.summary: Unlock writes through the Password object, then enable central heat with ch_enbl_1 (BV 1) and write the CH setpoint (AV 37), or run lead/lag with the lead/lag switch and setpoint. Read burner control status, outlet temperature, firing rate, the lockout code and the alert records.

minimum_points.name: pswd_w_1
minimum_points.why: Write the unlock code first; 0 relocks

integration.enable: Write the unlock code given in the manual to AV 101 Password (W) before changing any point; write 0 to relock (the boiler also relocks after 10 minutes without activity). Then BV 1 ch_enbl_1 enables central heat and AV 37 sets the CH setpoint; BV 15 and AV 84 do the same for lead/lag, and AV 75 picks the lead/lag setpoint source (0 local, 1 Modbus, 2 4-20 mA).
integration.heartbeat: No heartbeat object. Write access drops back to locked after 10 minutes of inactivity, so the BMS has to unlock again before later writes.
setup: The UPC translator (kit 383-600-304) talks to the boiler's SOLA control through the S7999D display Modbus gateway (COM 2, 38400 bps default on the SOLA side).
BAS side: BACnet MS/TP (9600-76.8 kbps) or BACnet over ARC156 on Port 1a; MAC address from the two rotary switches (default translator address 10), baud and protocol from DIP switches 1-8.
Set the translator address so it does not clash with the boiler Modbus addresses.
gotchas: Most settings come as pairs: a (W) object to write and a Status object to read back.
Cycle counts and run time are writable (W) as well; do not reset them by accident.
Lockout, alert and burner state codes are in Tables 3, 5 and 6 of the manual.

source.title: SlimFit Building Automation System Interface Instructions & Reference Guide - UPC BACnet translator
